concerns.location: tasks.md:T006 (Methodological note) vs constitution.md:Principle VII and spec.md:FR-007
concerns.text: Constitution Principle VII is NON-NEGOTIABLE: 'All correlation analyses ... MUST apply the Bonferroni correction'. T006 and the methodological note implement FDR (Benjamini–Hochberg) instead. The plan itself flags this as a kickback-requiring deviation, yet the spec and constitution remain unamended — the tasks execute a constitution violation. Either amend the constitution/spec first (documented amendment per governance) or restore Bonferroni in T006.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T006 check_sample_size vs spec.md:FR-010, US-3 scenario 4
concerns.text: FR-010: 'halt with a warning if the threshold is not met'. T006 weakens to 'log ... and proceed with effect-size/CI estimation flagged as underpowered'. This is a silent retroactive narrowing of a MUST-halt requirement; the spec has not been amended to authorize the plan's deviation.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T006 shapiro_diagnostics vs spec.md:FR-012, US-3 scenario 1
concerns.text: FR-012 requires Shapiro-Wilk to SELECT Pearson vs Spearman. T006 repurposes Shapiro-Wilk as a residual diagnostic only; no task implements method selection. The LME replacement of FR-006/FR-012 is plan-introduced and unratified by the spec — the tasks drop the FR-012 acceptance criterion entirely.

FR-006 mandates stratified Pearson/Spearman correlation; T006 implements LME with a global-coherence covariate. The covariate and LME framing are not in any spec FR. Tasks must not silently supersede an FR — the spec must be amended (with the deviation documented) before tasks implement the replacement.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T006 (24 models) vs plan.md:Statistical Rigor (30 tests)
concerns.text: Internal inconsistency in the FDR test family: plan says '3 metrics x 5 stages x 2 bands = 30 tests'; T006 fits '3 × 4 × 2 = 24 models' (Wake excluded). The correction family definition differs across artifacts; pick one and reconcile (the schema's stage enum supports 4 stages, so 24 is defensible — but plan.md must match).

concerns.location: tasks.md:T002/T003 vs spec.md:US-1 (Wake labeling) and US-2 scenario 3
concerns.text: Spec epoching labels Wake/N1/N2/N3/REM and plan counts 5 stages, but T003 aggregation and the dataset schema restrict to N1–REM. The Wake exclusion is a scoping decision never reconciled in the spec; make the staging explicit in spec.md rather than silently narrowing in tasks.
